- No card was filed and the tasks did not change.
- The person-level event costs sum to 39,779 µUSD, which is exactly the session's spent figure (L4-selftasks-103 and -108 hold).
- No check ran after the README task (no heading in its report). The README task (CHF 0.08 budget) was reviewed and ended Done.
- Costs (04-w1-04-costs) shows By specialist "checking the task list" and By task "Checking the task list" (L4-selftasks-114 holds). A project that had an intake still reads "planning" / "Planning and chat".

Walk 2 (SAYS '"Write the FAQ" is done when ...|The person must confirm the phone number on contact.html'). "Garden club" at Standard.
- Overview (08) reads "Waiting for you: 1 suggestion" (L4-selftasks-112 (b) holds).

Walk 3 ("Word count" at Assisted, made with New task, no plan).
- The Assisted session plan card still shows lowercase "approve" / "reject" with no explanations (12). L4-selftasks-115 is not done; it is inside the cut line.
- The suggestion card (13) has the step "Asks you first: no task of Word count is for the writer yet." Nothing on it says "plan you approved" or "writer-marketing" (L4-selftasks-111 holds).
- The same card, at Assisted, also lists 'Asks you first: "Write the FAQ" is a task you added or changed yourself.' as a bullet among the changes (see non-blocking: L4-selftasks-113's card half).
- Chat "fix the tasks: "Style the page" is two jobs ..." (15, 16; GET /projects/:id/conversation):

  - At Standard it starts 'Asks you first: "Style the page" is a task you added or changed yourself.' (L4-selftasks-113's chat half holds).

Walk 4/5 (L4-selftasks-101). A brief-made "Tea room" plan card, with the stored plan's build task budget set to USD 0.04, as the live model's plan set one.
- GET /inbox planTasks[0].note and the Inbox card (18-w4-01-plan-card-review-warning.png) show the orange line '"Build the page ...": its budget of CHF 0.03 may leave too little for its review, which then waits for Continue.'
- With a roomy budget the line does not show.
- Approve and start: both tasks ended Done with reviews.
- The bench cannot exercise the review sizing. Its fake provider prices 1 µUSD per token, so every critic call asked max_tokens 8192, for the CHF 0.08 and the CHF 0.03 task alike. The sizing is proven only by the composed test on Sonnet 5.5 prices (below).

Walk 6: Redo on a Done task. The row right after (Ready) shows "—" in the Critic column (L4-selftasks-112 (c) holds). The task then waits for Start, as D6 says.

blocking.issue: L4-selftasks-109: Undo after a restart is not tested. The acceptance line requires it, and validation rule 4 says an Undo is tested after a restart.
blocking.where: packages/commands/test/project-join.test.ts:645-705 (single in-memory store); packages/commands/src/commands/project-join.ts:240-271 and :524-552 (the persisted summary_cache notes and the withdrawn/reopened cards)
blocking.evidence: Acceptance: 'after project.join the kept project holds the closing project's task_list_notes and GET /inbox shows one open task_proposal card; Undo after a restart puts both back as they were.' The only test runs join and Undo in one in-memory store. The fixer's not_done reason is 'commands test world is in-memory'. But packages/runtime/test/project-join.test.ts already composes the real daemon twice on one home (its OJ-02 case at :167-211). A scratch case there passes on this branch: the join over /commands/execute, a restart, GET /inbox with one open suggestion, then POST /changes/:id/undo, a restart, two open suggestions and the notes back. So the state is persisted in summary_cache and request status, but no committed test proves it.
blocking.expected: A composed case in packages/runtime/test/project-join.test.ts (its own describe 'l4-selftasks-check, run L4'). Two projects on one folder, each with task_list_notes and an open task_proposal card. Join through /commands/execute, compose again on the same home, and assert the open cards in GET /inbox and the kept project's notes. Then POST /changes/:id/undo, compose again, and assert both cards are open and the notes are back. Close with settleSessions and removeHomes.

blocking.issue: L4-selftasks-101: the plan card's warning has no test at the person's boundary. Its only test calls planTaskViews with a hand-written estimator stub, so the GET /inbox wiring (deps.estimate and deps.workBudget in server.ts) and the IntakeCard render are untested.
blocking.evidence: fix_scope (1) asks for 'a real-daemon case for GET /inbox's intake card line'. The acceptance asks that 'GET /inbox's intake card shows ... its budget of CHF 0.08 may leave too little for its review, which then waits for Continue.' L4-selftasks-101 is listed 'Never in not_done'. grep finds the sentence only in w15-words.test.ts (a unit call with `estimate.of` hand-written) and in the older Start-dialog cases. reviewMayWaitOf returns null whenever deps.workBudget or deps.estimate is missing, so a wiring slip would hide the owner's warning ('it should get a warning') and no test would fail. On the bench the line does render (18-w4-01-plan-card-review-warning.png), but only after I patched the stored card: the stand-in intake writes no task budgets.

Optionally an InboxPage IntakeCard render assertion of the line.

non_blocking: L4-selftasks-113's card half is not built and not in not_done: at Assisted the session's suggestion card still lists 'Asks you first: "Write the FAQ" is a task you added or changed yourself.' as a bullet among the changes (bench 13-w3-02-inbox-suggestion-card-assisted.png), the sentence 113 removed from chat at Assisted. Note the spec conflicts: L4-selftasks-111's acceptance wants 'Asks you first: no task of Word count is for the writer yet.' in the steps of an Assisted card. The session lead should pick one rule (the triage proposed a separate RequestView field for the reasons) and record it in the report's not_done.

Max-effort sibling of L4-money-303 (packages/critic/src/critic.ts:481 and :597-609): floorUsdMicro always uses REVIEW_MIN_TOKENS_PER_CALL (2,048) out. But a max-effort review is never sized down (sizedToRoom requires !maxEffort), so its first call needs the input plus 8,192 tokens out. For a tier 3 review with a task budget whose room lies between those two prices, the review starts, its checks run, and the first call is refused (the money-303 symptom). The window is now wider than before (the old floor was 8,192 out alone). Suggest least = maxEffort ? out : REVIEW_MIN_TOKENS_PER_CALL. No money is passed; the hooks still refuse.

L4-selftasks-101's other decision part, raising a model-proposed task budget to its estimate with review before the plan card shows it, is in not_done. The reason given ('a raised budget must be shown on the plan card before approval') misreads the decision, which raises it before the card is shown. The acceptance allows 'the raised budget or' the warning, and the warning is built, so the session lead decides whether the raise is still wanted.

The fixer's claim that session-task-list.test.ts has L4-selftasks-105 cases does not hold. The session-path acceptance part (the card lists 2 lines and is applied via requestView(row).options[0]) is untested, though the fence fix is shared with chat.

L4-selftasks-103 acceptance says the line 'quotes the flagged line whole'. quoteOf caps it at 100 characters with '…' and turns double quotes into single ones (report-007: '... take every other open…'). A long instruction whose dangerous part sits at its end could be hidden from the person. Consider a higher cap for the no-change line, or state the choice in ADR 0119.

evals/registry/critic/critic.md 1.4.0 shortened two existing bullets to stay within the 120-line limit. It drops 'grade the diff by reading' and 'whatever you grade, and goes to the person'. These are instruction changes beyond the one line the spec asked for; name them for phase F's F-16 calibration.

Bench limitation for the live step: the fake provider prices 1 µUSD per token, so no bench walk can show the review sized to the room. The session lead's live step for L4-selftasks-101 should check, in the model-call log, a critic call with max_tokens below 8192 on a CHF 0.08 task.

fence order-into-pending-add (task-check.ts:1104-1120): a waitsFor name that is neither stored nor pending is silently dropped instead of refused in words, and the loop check is not re-run for the extra waits.
Words: the Details line 'Left out: the add of "Write thanks.html": ...' uses 'add' as a noun. The plan card's note repeats the task's title right under that task's own row.
L4-selftasks-115 (cut line, not_done): the Assisted session plan card still shows lowercase 'approve' / 'reject' with no explanation lines (bench 12-w3-01-inbox-session-plan-card).
